claims.title: Unauthenticated raw, non-graceful error exposure via /rest/user/security-question, /redirect and /api/Feedbacks/ (inconsistent error handling)
Unauthenticated exposure of Prometheus observability telemetry via /metrics
Cleartext CAPTCHA answer returned by GET /rest/captcha (CAPTCHA bypass via answer leak)
Unauthenticated account enumeration and security-question disclosure via /rest/user/security-question?email=
Excessive data exposure: unauthenticated /rest/memories returns full user objects including password hashes and tokens
Unauthenticated write gap: POST /api/SecurityAnswers/ accepts writes without authorization while the read is gated
Unauthenticated PUT mass-assignment on /api/Products/{id} (missing write authorization)

limitations: Replay validation tests submitted evidence against the hidden evaluator.
A high score is not proof of real-world bug-bounty performance.
The evaluator recomputed the cryptographic commitment from the hidden specification before scoring.
False negatives remain possible when the worker fails to submit reproducible evidence.
